arguments.value: This agreement says Bruce Jenner would provide speaking, marketing, and endorsement services for The Right Solution for one year. He would do up to six speaking events and five conference calls per month, help develop a business strategy and recruit distributors, and keep the terms confidential. In return, the company would pay him $10,000 upfront and $6,000 per month, provide products for his personal use, cover travel and first-class accommodations, and give him stock options tied to sales volume. Jenner would act as an independent contractor, not an employee, and each side could end the agreement if the other side failed to perform or if certain business or insolvency events occurred. The contract is governed by Nevada law and includes standard terms on confidentiality, indemnification, amendments, notices, and assignment.
